description: A literal whose binary exponent doesn't fit in 32 bits, such as 1e2147483647, is an error
notes: The spec requires an error only for a number that can't be represented exactly, and an arbitrary-precision decimal can represent 10^2147483647, so the spec doesn't decide. hashicorp/hcl parses literals with go-cty's ParseNumberVal, which uses math/big: it rejects a literal whose binary exponent before scaling (the mantissa's bit length plus the decimal exponent, less any fraction digits) doesn't fit in a 32-bit integer, while a smaller one that overflows while scaling becomes infinity (native/numbers/exponent-overflow-becomes-infinity).
